problem_text:
A shipping company must allocate cargo space across 10 distinct types of commodities, each requiring 10 sequential handling stages to be prepared for transit.  
The revenue generated per ton of each commodity is listed below:  
* Commodity Alpha yields 16.926 per ton  
* Commodity Beta yields 13.975 per ton  
* Commodity Gamma yields 10.341 per ton  
* Commodity Delta yields 5.11 per ton  
* Commodity Epsilon yields 15.422 per ton  
* Commodity Zeta yields 17.754 per ton  
* Commodity Eta yields 5.145 per ton  
* Commodity Theta yields 14.259 per ton  
* Commodity Iota yields 10.168 per ton  
* Commodity Kappa yields 11.161 per ton  

The handling duration required per ton for each stage is as follows:  
* For Commodity Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.52 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.98, Stage 3 consumes 1.189, Stage 4 consumes 1.448, Stage 5 consumes 1.388, Stage 6 consumes 1.056, Stage 7 consumes 1.166, Stage 8 consumes 1.361, Stage 9 consumes 0.224, Stage 10 consumes 0.242.  
* For Commodity Beta, Stage 1 consumes 1.038, Stage 2 consumes 1.473, Stage 3 consumes 1.912, Stage 4 consumes 1.148, Stage 5 consumes 1.413, Stage 6 consumes 1.858, Stage 7 consumes 0.379, Stage 8 consumes 0.429, Stage 9 consumes 1.058, Stage 10 consumes 1.221.  
* For Commodity Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.747, Stage 2 consumes 0.895, Stage 3 consumes 1.765, Stage 4 consumes 1.156, Stage 5 consumes 1.232, Stage 6 consumes 1.871, Stage 7 consumes 1.271, Stage 8 consumes 1.032, Stage 9 consumes 0.521, Stage 10 consumes 0.544.  
* For Commodity Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.11, Stage 2 consumes 0.282, Stage 3 consumes 1.116, Stage 4 consumes 1.785, Stage 5 consumes 0.899, Stage 6 consumes 1.709, Stage 7 consumes 1.553, Stage 8 consumes 1.664, Stage 9 consumes 0.808, Stage 10 consumes 1.298.  
* For Commodity Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.375, Stage 2 consumes 0.379, Stage 3 consumes 0.506, Stage 4 consumes 1.409, Stage 5 consumes 1.498, Stage 6 consumes 0.273, Stage 7 consumes 1.073, Stage 8 consumes 1.063, Stage 9 consumes 0.964, Stage 10 consumes 1.574.  
* For Commodity Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.947, Stage 2 consumes 0.256, Stage 3 consumes 1.873, Stage 4 consumes 1.526, Stage 5 consumes 0.888, Stage 6 consumes 0.624, Stage 7 consumes 1.258, Stage 8 consumes 1.163, Stage 9 consumes 1.907, Stage 10 consumes 1.954.  
* For Commodity Eta, Stage 1 consumes 1.602, Stage 2 consumes 1.78, Stage 3 consumes 1.445, Stage 4 consumes 1.614, Stage 5 consumes 1.16, Stage 6 consumes 1.462, Stage 7 consumes 0.986, Stage 8 consumes 1.859, Stage 9 consumes 1.848, Stage 10 consumes 1.994.  
* For Commodity Theta, Stage 1 consumes 0.661, Stage 2 consumes 0.591, Stage 3 consumes 1.31, Stage 4 consumes 0.865, Stage 5 consumes 0.914, Stage 6 consumes 1.59, Stage 7 consumes 1.417, Stage 8 consumes 1.737, Stage 9 consumes 1.655, Stage 10 consumes 1.082.  
* For Commodity Iota, Stage 1 consumes 0.388, Stage 2 consumes 0.96, Stage 3 consumes 1.621, Stage 4 consumes 0.861, Stage 5 consumes 1.716, Stage 6 consumes 0.918, Stage 7 consumes 1.672, Stage 8 consumes 1.566, Stage 9 consumes 1.409, Stage 10 consumes 0.213.  
* For Commodity Kappa, Stage 1 consumes 1.866, Stage 2 consumes 0.861, Stage 3 consumes 0.366, Stage 4 consumes 0.223, Stage 5 consumes 1.75, Stage 6 consumes 0.953, Stage 7 consumes 1.256, Stage 8 consumes 1.972, Stage 9 consumes 1.883, Stage 10 consumes 1.334.  

Each handling stage has a fixed maximum available labor-hours:  
* Stage 1 cannot exceed 333.386 hours  
* Stage 2 cannot exceed 222.213 hours  
* Stage 3 cannot exceed 221.996 hours  
* Stage 4 cannot exceed 266.653 hours  
* Stage 5 cannot exceed 231.891 hours  
* Stage 6 cannot exceed 256.784 hours  
* Stage 7 cannot exceed 223.192 hours  
* Stage 8 cannot exceed 327.785 hours  
* Stage 9 cannot exceed 261.034 hours  
* Stage 10 cannot exceed 261.1 hours  

Under the condition that the total handling time for each stage—Stage 1 through Stage 10—must remain within its respective hourly limit, determine the optimal tonnage of each commodity to handle so as to maximize the total revenue.
